requirement.description: The rlp_encode function fails to properly encode strings and lists in text mode. Many test cases return '0x00' instead of correct RLP encodings.
requirement.contract: Implement complete RLP encoding for text mode strings and lists. Strings should be encoded with proper length prefixes (0x80 for empty, 0x00-0x7f for single bytes, 0x80+n for longer strings), and lists with 0xc0+n prefix. All test cases in test_rlp_encoding.py must pass.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode_address_nonce_tuple function incorrectly handles address-nonce tuple encoding.
requirement.contract: Fix the address-nonce tuple encoding to correctly combine address and nonce with proper RLP prefix calculation. The function must correctly encode tuples like [address, nonce] according to RLP specification.

requirement.description: The private_key_to_address function fails to correctly derive Ethereum addresses from private keys.
requirement.contract: Fix the private_key_to_address function to properly derive Ethereum addresses by hashing the uncompressed public key and extracting the last 20 bytes. The implementation must match the expected test results.

requirement.description: The get_created_address function fails to correctly implement CREATE2 address derivation.
requirement.contract: Correct the CREATE2 address derivation by properly concatenating 0xff, sender, salt, and keccak256(init_code) and extracting the last 20 bytes of the resulting hash.

requirement.description: The rlp_encode function does not handle integer encoding correctly for large values.
requirement.contract: Complete integer encoding for values that require multi-byte length prefixes. Ensure integers are encoded with proper prefix values (0x80 for 0, 0x00-0x7f for single byte values, 0x80+n for longer values).
